items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The transcript only mentions Jack Walker in the context of commentary on an album; the interviewee (Maxine Sullivan) does not speak about a personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: And, of course, under the music, there was commentary there. Originally when we did the show, Canada Lee did the commentary. And on that particular album on this particular date, Canada Lee was no longer with us either.
And Jack Walker did the commentary.
